name: system-analysis-design
description: App Summary and Requirements The inventory tracking app was designed and developed to address the real-world need for efficient, accurate, and user-friendly stock management. The primary goal was to provide users with a streamlined digital solution to monitor inventory levels, add new items, update existing records, and securely authenticate user credentials. By bridging backend data persistence with a clean mobile interface, the app solves common inventory management pain points such as stock discrepancies and cumbersome manual tracking.
